policy.runtime_materialization: Only independently source-specific reader-ready rows may enter the runtime ledger; other completed waves remain preserved research receipts.
policy.validation_strategy: 200 findings authored before consolidated admission/runtime/repository verification

waves.focus: prebiotic/probiotic/synbiotic interventions for anxiety and depression; GRADE meta-analysis
2026 depression probiotic systematic review/meta-analysis; preserve strain/population heterogeneity
probiotics in multiple sclerosis; preserve disease-specific and strain-specific boundaries
12 RCTs/1,113 participants; fecal Lactobacillus/Bifidobacterium and fasting glucose; microbiome endpoints distinct from clinical efficacy
athlete biotics umbrella/re-analysis; immune/inflammatory biomarkers, not performance efficacy
early-life probiotic/synbiotic respiratory-infection prevention in children <=24 months; strain-specific
substrate-utilization evidence; explicitly not proof of fat loss
proanthocyanidin/GSPE review; only one human RCT among 15 studies, 54 athletes, OPC 210 mg/day for 9 days; very-low certainty
pediatric ADHD randomized trial; age/safety-specific extraction required before any claim
depression GRADE systematic review/meta-analysis; keep formulation and psychiatric-population boundaries
pediatric asthma; 6 RCTs/731; immune-biomarker signals but clinical outcomes null; TSA inconclusive; very-low certainty
pediatric asthma; 8 RCTs/902; acute episode RR signal and FEV1/FVC signal; reconcile rather than overwrite PMID 41561940
pediatric functional abdominal pain disorders; 21 trials/1,899; modest pain/episode signals; complete resolution 35.3% vs 22.8%, NNT ~7; responder-threshold advantage null
pediatric functional abdominal pain network meta-analysis; strain-specific and heterogeneous
knee osteoarthritis probiotic evidence; exploratory strain-specific efficacy with no significant adverse-event difference
healthy-population gut-diversity evidence; 47 studies, 22 quantitative, 1,068 participants; Shannon and several alpha-diversity metrics null
Centella asiatica CA-HE50 300 mg/day for 6 months, n=80; MPOD improved; surrogate ophthalmic endpoint, not AMD treatment/prevention; product-specific
Perilla frutescens var. acuta leaf ethanol extract 500 mg/day for 12 weeks, n=100; K-MMSE-2/ADAS-Cog improved; amyloid-beta and BDNF null; product-specific
mixed hot-water + supercritical CO2 Curcuma longa extract, n=40, 24 weeks; selected attention/orientation endpoints positive among many; small/multiple-endpoint caution
300 mg twice daily for 8 weeks, n=50 older adults; OPQOL/ESS/fitness signals; extract/provenance-specific
proprietary Ashwa APB, n=141 with moderate stress/anxiety; two 300 mg twice-daily formulations vs placebo for 8 weeks; product-specific
Phase III Ashwagen 300 mg twice daily stress/anxiety trial in adults with hypertension/cardiometabolic risk, n=60; exact source-specific results required
synbiotic oxidative-stress meta-analysis; 18 RCTs; biomarker effects, GRADE very low-to-moderate; retracted/serious-concern trials excluded
standardized injectable Ginkgo preparation (SXNI), 22 trials/2,375; route-specific and must remain separate from oral Ginkgo
lutein/carotenoid randomized-trial meta-analysis in AMD; ophthalmic disease-specific; exact intervention-node attribution required
large review across inhalation and oral lavender studies; route and Silexan identity must remain distinct
clinical systematic review of saffron for depression; preserve extract source, standardization, duration, safety, and trial limitations
anxiety/depression meta-analysis; route and participant health state contribute to heterogeneity; avoid route-free efficacy claim
12-study depression synthesis; placebo benefit and broad comparability to antidepressants in included trials with adverse-event incidence not significantly different; preserve trial limits
human cognition systematic review/meta-analysis; preserve ginseng species/preparation and healthy-vs-impaired population boundaries
pregnancy nausea/vomiting systematic review; pregnancy-specific antiemetic evidence only
seven randomized placebo-controlled hypertension trials; BP signal with need for stronger long-term trials; formulation/population specific
beetroot juice blood-pressure meta-analysis; preserve juice/nitrate intervention identity and subgroup heterogeneity
pediatric respiratory-infection review; five pediatric studies with symptom-duration/antibiotic-use signals and risk-of-bias concerns
six 12-week randomized human trials using several Bacopa extracts; memory-focused outcomes; extract and duration firewall
nine double-blind hypertension trials/482 participants; BP reductions with high heterogeneity
2026 umbrella review/meta-synthesis for pregnancy nausea/vomiting; pregnancy-specific review-level evidence
systematic review of 109 randomized-trial papers; indication-by-indication interpretation required; no broad all-purpose ginger efficacy claim
chemotherapy-induced nausea/vomiting systematic review/meta-analysis; oncology-treatment context only
19-RCT fatigue synthesis; overall pooled fatigue reduction not significant, with small subgroup signals; preserve overall null
systematic review of fatigue evidence; modest/promising evidence with limited eligible studies and low reported adverse-event burden
red ginseng in type 2 diabetes; four RCTs with no convincing fasting-glucose or insulin benefit; retain as formulation-specific counterweight
fatigue and physical-performance meta-analysis; subjective fatigue and objective performance must remain separate
26-trial metabolic-syndrome/related-disorder synthesis; glycemic and lipid endpoints remain phenotype- and formulation-specific
umbrella review/update for Curcuma longa-related glucose outcomes in T2DM, prediabetes, and metabolic syndrome; preparation identity and review overlap must be preserved
14 trials/573 participants; pooled systolic blood-pressure signal with duration/dose variation; juice-specific intervention
historical eight-RCT IBS meta-analysis; possible symptom relief but substantial methodological limitations and insufficient certainty
10 RCTs/706 participants with type 2 diabetes; several glycemic/lipid signals while HOMA-IR, LDL, and BMI were null; mild GI effects reported
adjunctive hawthorn evidence in NYHA I-III chronic heart failure; 13 qualifying trials, 8 trials/632 in meta-analysis; preserve adjunctive-use boundary
14 studies/15 effect sizes; lipid changes with juice-versus-extract differences by outcome; preparation-specific
randomized-trial synthesis of Rhodiola for fatigue/stress-related outcomes; preserve extract identity, endpoint differences, and heterogeneous quality
depressive-symptom systematic review/meta-analysis; keep mild/subthreshold populations separate from diagnosed major depression and preserve adjunct/monotherapy distinctions
blood-pressure systematic review/meta-analysis; preserve tea/extract identity, baseline BP, dosing/duration heterogeneity, and lack of cardiovascular-event evidence
catechin/EGCG randomized-trial synthesis for blood-pressure/cardiometabolic endpoints; keep extract/catechin products distinct from brewed tea
green-tea catechin/caffeine weight-outcome synthesis; generally small preparation-dependent effects; not standalone weight-loss treatment evidence
recurrent UTI prevention evidence; preserve population, adherence and formulation differences; not treatment of active infection
randomized evidence for recurrent UTI prevention remains limited/inconsistent; prevention-versus-treatment boundary
common-cold prevention/treatment synthesis with mixed effects across preparations, outcomes and timing
Cochrane evidence indicating little or no meaningful urinary-symptom improvement versus placebo for typical saw-palmetto preparations; important null/counterweight
older BPH systematic review suggesting possible modest urinary-symptom benefit but small trials and limited long-term evidence
lower-urinary-tract/BPH evidence for pumpkin-seed preparations; heterogeneous seed-oil/extract/product identity prevents generic treatment claim
BPH evidence includes combination products and older trials; isolated nettle-root efficacy remains uncertain
systematic review of sexual function/libido; limited evidence with few trials and methodological limitations
menopausal-symptom human evidence remains small and heterogeneous; symptoms distinct from hormone-level claims
sexual-function systematic review/meta-analysis; insufficient/inconsistent meaningful erectile-function evidence; preserve counterweight to testosterone marketing
standardized-extract randomized evidence for sexual-function outcomes; proprietary extract and healthy/male population limits; culinary fenugreek not interchangeable
male-fertility evidence in stressed/infertile men; semen/hormonal outcomes are population-, extract-, duration-, and surrogate-specific
valerian+hops sleep trials are combination-product evidence and cannot be attributed to valerian alone
controlled chronic-use human evidence with selected memory outcomes; preserve extract identity and delayed/chronic rather than acute nootropic framing
randomized healthy-adult evidence does not establish broad cognitive enhancement; retain null/counterweight evidence
dementia cognition/function evidence is mixed and standardized-extract/disease-population specific
controlled-trial review with possible domain-specific acute cognitive signals; limited evidence and acute-vs-chronic boundary
chronic-fatigue systematic review; limited/inconsistent evidence with fatigue diagnosis/context and preparation identity attached
acute cognitive-performance randomized evidence in healthy adults; species, formulation, and acute time-course firewall
controlled human stress/attention evidence; isolated L-theanine versus tea and acute-versus-chronic exposure remain distinct
2026 mood-disorder SR/MA; preserve heterogeneous diagnoses/regimens, adjunct-vs-monotherapy status, and risk-of-bias boundaries.
46-RCT neurological/psychiatric systematic review; outcome-by-outcome certainty, formulation, combinations and heterogeneity remain explicit.
CKD-specific zinc evidence; cannot be inherited by healthy populations or generic zinc claims.
large metabolic RCT synthesis; biomarker endpoints remain distinct from disease-treatment claims.
MASLD-specific evidence; disease/population boundary prevents generic metabolic claims.
PMS-specific evidence; do not generalize to depression, dysmenorrhea or other mood indications.
13 RCTs/2,451 cognition synthesis with I² 96%; signal attenuated after excluding high-risk studies.
cohort disease-risk associations and randomized FMD/insulin findings remain separated; sponsor provenance retained.
impaired-glucose-tolerance RCT; preparation/remission definition require exact extraction and IGT remission is not diabetes prevention/treatment.
umbrella review of 128 biotics SR/MAs; strain/population variability and pediatric sepsis safety concerns retained.
phytosterol/stanol umbrella evidence is category-level and must not be inherited by beta-sitosterol or individual products without identity match.
14 RCTs/2,856 in COPD; exacerbation findings stay COPD- and regimen-specific.
12 RCTs/904 depression; modest adjunctive psychiatric effect with diagnosis/co-treatment boundaries.
chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy context only; no transfer to idiopathic neuropathy.
MASLD RCT synthesis; liver/lipid/CRP signals with anthropometric nulls; disease-specific.
9 RCTs/525; weight, BMI, waist and WHR null—counterweight to weight-loss marketing.
8 RCTs; small systolic-BP signal while DBP/endothelial markers were non-significant; surrogate limits retained.
PCOS phenotype-response evidence; stereoisomer/formulation and PCOS boundaries remain attached.
18 RCTs/898 cardiometabolic synthesis; modest changes with high heterogeneity and low/very-low anthropometric certainty.
prenatal omega-3 and offspring cognition; prenatal exposure/developmental outcomes must not be merged with adult cognition.
14 placebo-controlled liver-disease trials; mortality and most liver outcomes null, small ALT signal not robust in higher-quality/longer trials.
3 RCTs/151 older adults with insomnia; sleep-onset latency signal with small, age-specific evidence base.
review spanning Rhodiola and Withania psychometrics; only Rhodiola-specific findings may attach to Rhodiola.
proprietary low-dose extract RCT in 60 stressed adults for 28 days; short-duration/product/industry provenance retained.
12 studies/819; triglyceride/SBP signals with low/very-low certainty for several other biomarkers; hypertension subgroup boundaries.
multicenter DB-RCT, 621 participants, 12 weeks; modest 24-h SBP effect with secondary metabolic endpoints and extract-specific boundary.
Cochrane major-depression review; comparator, trial quality and standardized-preparation boundaries retained.
depression SR/MA; heterogeneity and product standardization limits remain visible.
clinical interaction review documenting CYP/P-gp induction; safety evidence is first-class.
BPH systematic review; limited clinically important urinary benefit and preparation-specificity.
menopausal vasomotor RCT review; mixed evidence and preparation variability.
menopause review; inconsistent efficacy, with liver-safety evidence kept separate from efficacy.
atopic-eczema systematic review with insufficient benefit; historical null/counterweight.
cyclical mastalgia review; limited indication-specific evidence.
recurrent-UTI Cochrane review; preventive population/formulation/adherence specificity and no active-UTI treatment inference.
older UTI-prevention review; historical heterogeneity and uncertainty retained.
recurrent-UTI prevention systematic review; limited heterogeneous evidence.
randomized prevention evidence; possible benefit but small studies/comparator differences and low certainty.
common-cold systematic review; inconsistent across species, preparations and outcomes.
respiratory randomized evidence; prevention, incidence and symptom-duration endpoints stay separate.
upper-respiratory-infection systematic review; preparation/method heterogeneity retained.
common-cold randomized review; limited certainty and no chronic-respiratory generalization.
upper-respiratory symptom systematic review; possible duration signal with limited high-quality trials.
DGL GI review; mixed evidence and strict DGL-vs-glycyrrhizin-containing licorice firewall.
hypertension/hypokalemia/fluid-retention safety evidence; glycyrrhizin dose/formulation dependent.
dementia RCT review; uncertain clinical benefit and standardized-extract boundary.
cognitive-impairment evidence; no transfer to healthy-nootropic claims.
tinnitus systematic review with insufficient meaningful benefit; indication-specific null.
acute cognition randomized evidence; domain-specific, short-term, no long-term neuroprotection inference.
glycemic systematic review; heterogeneous species/preparations/metabolic status and endpoints.
fatigue systematic review; small heterogeneous trials and occupational/athletic context.
exercise-performance randomized evidence; mixed results and performance-vs-subjective-fatigue separation.
sexual-function systematic review; limited evidence and small samples.
menopause randomized evidence; limited and not transferable from sexual-function evidence.
insufficient evidence for testosterone/erectile-function claims; negative/uncertain counterweight.
lactation systematic review; limited milk-volume evidence, methodological weaknesses and separate lactation safety review required.
glycemic systematic review; possible glucose changes with variable quality/preparations.
glycemic systematic review; limited human evidence and strict human-vs-preclinical boundary.
lipid/metabolic human evidence; limited and heterogeneous.
T2D meta-analysis; selected glycemic signals with heterogeneous seed/oil/extract interventions.
metabolic-syndrome randomized evidence; small studies and surrogate outcomes.
blood-pressure synthesis; possible reductions with substantial heterogeneity and preparation/baseline-BP boundaries.
BP meta-analysis; modest endpoint-specific effects with extract standardization requirements.
endothelial/cardiovascular biomarker RCT evidence; surrogate outcomes only.
metabolic systematic review; mixed biomarker effects and nulls retained.
hypertension randomized evidence; modest BP signal, preparation-specific and short-duration.
cardiometabolic human evidence; variable populations/preparations and tea-vs-extract firewall.
weight meta-analysis; small heterogeneous effects across catechin/caffeine products and no fat-burner framing.
hepatotoxicity systematic review; concentrated-extract safety warning distinct from brewed tea.
knee-OA systematic review/meta-analysis; formulation-sensitive symptom evidence.
inflammatory-marker meta-analysis; surrogate outcomes and heterogeneous formulations.
older OA/back-pain systematic review; some pain evidence with small/variable trials.
topical pain RCT evidence includes homeopathic and non-homeopathic preparations; topical formulations must not be merged with oral arnica.
small human Centella anxiety evidence; acute-testing context and limited certainty.
human sleep synthesis; possible sleep-quality effects with heterogeneous endpoints/formulations and no insomnia-treatment inference.
sleep evidence in older adults with complaints; limited/heterogeneous, magnesium form and baseline status matter.
anxiety review; possible selected-population benefit with variable quality and co-intervention confounding.
adjunctive depression meta-analysis; possible symptom benefit with limited certainty and antidepressant co-treatment boundary.
fatigue SR/MA; selected chronic-condition populations and no inference of underlying disease treatment.
migraine clinical evidence; possible frequency/duration effects with small trials.
hypertensive-population RCT synthesis; whole seed vs oil/lignan preparation boundary.
lipid RCT meta-analysis; modest changes with preparation/endpoint heterogeneity.
GAD randomized evidence; possible benefit with limited sample sizes and standardized-preparation boundary.
hormonal systematic review/meta-analysis; sex, baseline endocrine status, extract and surrogate nature of hormone measures.
20 studies/1,249; domain-specific cognition/physical-function signals with extract/duration boundaries and null body-composition outcomes.
large healthy-adult safety RCT corpus node; standardized-extract/population/duration boundaries and reconciliation with existing safety evidence.
root-extract skin/hair randomized evidence; product, dose/duration and funding require exact source-specific extraction.
Cognivia proprietary Salvia combination; combination-specific cognition evidence and no inheritance to generic sage.
MenoSan fresh-herb ethanolic Salvia officinalis trial in menopausal women; symptom improvements with GU nulls and product specificity.
allergic-rhinitis node with mixed animal/human evidence; human extraction required before claim materialization.
bone-health review with published correction provenance that must travel with downstream evidence.
Bifidobacterium animalis BB-12 safety evidence; strain-specific safety only.
Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus safety evidence; strain-specific safety only.
13-RCT mood review spanning tea, extract, matcha, EGCG and L-theanine; intervention heterogeneity and BDNF null retained.
39 RCTs/4,094 sleep synthesis; small PSQI/objective signals, insomnia-severity null and very-low/low certainty.
30-RCT cognition/mood review; pooled working-memory/verbal/immediate-memory nulls despite selected qualitative signals.
8 RCTs/594 migraine review; acute/preventive evidence low-to-very-low certainty and too uncertain for established efficacy.
11 RCTs/870 knee-OA review; pain/function signals with high heterogeneity and oral collagen-preparation boundary.
20-RCT knee-OA network meta-analysis of Curcuma/Boswellia/mixed formulations; modified-formulation effects and combination uncertainty preserved.
50-RCT tea/theanine/caffeine synthesis; acute domain-specific cognition/mood effects and strict tea-vs-isolated-vs-combination identity.
19 randomized-trial articles/897; modest subjective sleep-domain effects with insufficient pure-L-theanine dose/duration evidence.
41 RCT articles/2,049 adults; LDL/total-cholesterol reductions, HDL/TG nulls and considerable heterogeneity.
7 RCTs across clinical populations; gut-microbiota shifts are mechanistic/associational and not causal proof of clinical benefit.
adult RCT meta-analysis of obesity indices; anthropometric endpoints/population boundaries retained.
31 RCTs/1,168 cognition/affect synthesis; acute attention signal, modest bias-sensitive stress effects, fatigue null and inconsistent anxiety.
13 sleep trials/550; studied 50–900 mg/day range is evidence metadata only, with author-industry provenance and no dosing recommendation.
Bacopa-vs-Ginkgo cognition network/indirect comparison; apparent memory ranking retains indirect-comparison limitations.
18 RCTs/498; inflammatory/oxidative signals heterogeneous/low certainty with origin/phenotype dependence.
5 studies/411 in early chronic venous disease; formulation-specific symptom/QoL evidence with sponsor provenance.
13 trials/802 dysglycemia synthesis; FPG signal with extreme heterogeneity and species-specific boundary.
chicory + green-tea insomnia study; combination-only null evidence cannot be attributed to either ingredient alone.
DHM + vitamins C/E + choline MASLD combination; no single-ingredient attribution.
perimenopausal shatavari root-extract RCT; deeper full-text extraction required before materialization.
Fenavari standardized shatavari + fenugreek combination RCT; combination-level evidence only.
Hippophae rhamnoides fruit-extract constipation RCT; product/indication specific.
rosemary + ginger pilot RCT for DNA-integrity/oxidative/endothelial biomarkers; combination and biomarker only.
AMBER EBUS procedural-cough trial; amla extract versus dextromethorphan/combination/placebo with active-arm boundary.
full-spectrum aqueous Amomum subulatum extract for focus/alertness/executive function; product provenance and quantitative extraction pending.
636-person prediabetes/early-T2D trial of five-plant polyphenol blend; modest FPG signals, subgroup/null outcomes and AE/SAE context.
NET1701 combination in men with LUTS; IPSS signal with Qmax/PVR null and combination-specificity.
distinct EMF_CWW combination in male climacteric syndrome; AMS/subdomain/ADAM/hormone between-group nulls and long-term-safety unknown.
published correction to probiotic cardiometabolic meta-analysis; corrected article must govern downstream numeric extraction.
sleep-supplement review used as an attribution firewall for multi-ingredient formulations; melatonin and botanicals stay separate.
pharmacovigilance adverse-event reporting synthesis; product detail incompleteness and reporting-rate limitations are safety-quality context.
seed-derived medicinal/edible-herb safety review; pediatric/excess-intake concentration, serious events and causality classifications retained.
